{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on: [push, workflow_dispatch]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    container:
      image: devkitpro/devkita64:latest

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Setup ccache
        uses: hendrikmuhs/ccache-action@v1.2

      - name: Install latest libnx (before building)
        run: |
          pushd /tmp
          git clone https://github.com/switchbrew/libnx
          cd libnx
          make clean
          make -j8 PREFIX="ccache aarch64-none-elf-"
          make install
          popd

      - name: Clear invalid ccache after libnx update 
        run: ccache -C

      - name: Build
        run: make -j8 PREFIX="ccache aarch64-none-elf-"

      - name: Upload built files
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: sdcard
          path: out/sd

      - name: Upload elf file
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ldn_mitm.elf
          path: ldn_mitm/ldn_mitm.elf

      - name: Upload elf file
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: overlay.elf
          path: overlay/overlay.elf",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs on every push and workflow_dispatch with no matrix, tests, Bazel, or schedule, so most patterns do not apply. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE fits: repeated pushes to the same branch supersede earlier in-progress builds, and canceling them avoids duplicate work while the newer run still provides build coverage. Preconditions are met (same workflow and branch; newer revision supersedes older checks). Contraindications do not apply (this is a build, not release/deployment; concurrency is keyed by branch so distinct branches are isolated). No required checks are configured, so canceling superseded runs does not break a required-check contract. The change is minimal: add a workflow-level concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, keyed by workflow and ref, preserving all existing steps, permissions, and artifacts.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
